attributes.alarm_description: Config Loader Lambda duration exceeds 80% of configured timeout — at risk of hard kill
Config Loader Lambda is being throttled — requests rejected before SF retry logic
DynamoDB 5xx errors — transient service-side failures on pipeline state table
DynamoDB throttled requests — bulk tag status writes from Glue hitting on-demand capacity limits
DynamoDB 4xx errors — bad requests against pipeline state table, likely a code bug (wrong table name, schema mismatch)
Extraction DLQ messages older than 6 hours — failures accumulating across runs without investigation
Messages in extraction-failures DLQ — at least one tag batch failed after all retries, data gap in this run
Glue transform job JVM heap usage exceeds 80% — OOM risk from large tag batches or wide shuffles
Glue validation job JVM heap usage exceeds 80% — OOM risk
Map state processor Lambda duration exceeds 80% of configured timeout
Map state processor Lambda is being throttled — high concurrency fan-out hitting account limits
Parent pipeline Step Function executions are being throttled
Parent pipeline execution timed out — usually a stuck Glue job or Lambda
More than 50 tags had all records quarantined in a single run (>1% of 5000 tags)
Validation rejection rate exceeds 15% — possible upstream schema change or API mutation rate shift
